canary_independent_arithmetic.claim_6: phi derivative is z^3+z; phi(1/2)=9/64, derivative(1/2)=5/8, yielding D(0,1/2)=11/64. Objective minus value at zero is phi(z)+abs(z)-5*z/8, nonnegative separately for z>=0 and z<0. Residual is -5*u/8. Strict convexity follows from second derivative 3*z^2+1>0. These ordinary mathematical checks are not Lean proof checks.
canary_independent_arithmetic.claim_7: Dq(a,b)=(a-b)^2/2. On [0,1], objective minus value at zero is z^2/2+2*z>=0. Residual is u. Boundary 0 belongs to V, while -1 does not. These ordinary mathematical checks are not Lean proof checks.
